annotations.text:
DCC_SHELL_SPEC §12, applied: 16x16 viewBox, fill none, stroke currentColor at 1.2, round caps and joins, ONE weight, no fills except a 0.7 dot where a mark must survive at 12 px, nothing inside a glyph smaller than 1 px at render size.

Drawn to join the shipped sculpt-feature family, which §12 describes as terrain cross-sections reading as one family -- so two or three strokes, no interior detail, and a horizon-like reading. A glyph of six paths would be wrong for this set even if it were prettier.

Where a shipped glyph already served the meaning it is marked reuse rather than redrawn.
